categories.title: The Collection
categories.description: Fifteen hundred objects, models and documents recording humanity's most confident mistakes. The permanent collection is arranged in four wings; highlights from each are presented here.

categories.title: Transport & Exploration
categories.description: Machines intended to move us faster, higher and further than physics, budgets or common sense would allow.

categories.title: Domestic Futures
categories.description: Appliances and homewares that promised to abolish household labour, weather, cooking and thought itself.

categories.title: Communication & Computing
categories.description: Devices for speaking, deciding and remembering at the speed of electricity — provided the electricity behaved.

categories.title: Architecture & Urbanism
categories.description: Cities, towers and infrastructure designed for populations that, regrettably, had other plans.

categories.title: Exhibitions
categories.description: Temporary exhibitions at the Museum of Unbuilt Futures.

categories.title: What's On
categories.description: Tours, lectures, workshops, screenings and after-hours events at the museum.

categories.title: Museum Journal
categories.description: Essays and field notes from the curators, archivists and conservators of the Museum of Unbuilt Futures.
